description: Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that makes diorite useful

releases.notes:
# Diorite Isn't Useless 0.3.0-beta

Someone used to work these mines. Now you can find out where.

![The mouth of an abandoned mine](https://github.com/Daio7771/DioriteIsntUseless/blob/main/docs/images/0.3.0-beta/mine_mouth.png?raw=true)

## What's new

### The abandoned diorite mine
A big one-floor maze buried somewhere between Y 0 and 40, different in every world. A small timber mouth on the surface hides a long ladder down. At the bottom: broken rails, old beams, dead ends, and signs that someone left for you. Somewhere in the middle there's a room that someone has been looking after. It's the only lit place down there.

There's a chest, too. Bring torches.

| | |
|---|---|
| ![Entrance corridor](https://github.com/Daio7771/DioriteIsntUseless/blob/main/docs/images/0.3.0-beta/mine_entrance.png?raw=true) | ![The room in the middle](https://github.com/Daio7771/DioriteIsntUseless/blob/main/docs/images/0.3.0-beta/crib_room.png?raw=true) |

Mines are rare. You won't need luck to find one, though. Someone knows where they are.

### The Miner's new routine
- **He comes in the morning.** Do his job, sleep in a bed under the open sky, and he'll be there when you wake up. If the job isn't done, or you sleep in a cave, he won't come.
- **Jobs come on paper.** Right-click it to see how far along you are and what it pays. When he pays you, he takes the old paper back and gives you the next one.
- **He talks more and writes less.** His instructions book is the only book you'll get from him. Everything else, he tells you himself.

## Changes
- The note in the top-left corner is gone. The job paper replaces it.
- The Miner no longer comes on a timer.

## Good to know
- Mines only appear in newly generated chunks. In an old world, travel to unexplored land.
- Worlds from 0.2 carry over. Your current job stays, and you'll get its paper on his next visit.
- Still Minecraft **1.20.1** (Fabric). The 1.21.1 port is planned for beta 4.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.20.1, Fabric Loader, Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin
- Optional: Cloth Config + Mod Menu (config screen)

Abuse mode is still on by default. There are no flashing lights. But there may be moments that make you jump.

Second beta for Fabric 1.20.1.

## New
- **The Miner**: an NPC that starts visiting once you smelt your first Diorite Crystals. He asks for favors (fell trees, dig with the pickaxe, bring crystals) and pays in emeralds or iron. Right-click to talk; a note in the top-left corner tracks the current favor while he's nearby.
- He talks in a speech bubble (also copied to chat) and gives you a book of instructions on his first visit.
- Only the player he visits can see or hear him. He doesn't fight, break blocks or follow you around.
- More Abuse Mode content. No details on purpose.
- New option `abuseMode.jumpscares` (default `true`, in Abuse mode → Advanced). Turn it off to keep the loud moments quiet.
- Disabling Abuse mode from the config screen now asks for confirmation.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.20.1, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+
- Fabric API 0.92.x
- Fabric Language Kotlin 1.14.1+kotlin.2.4.20+
- Optional, for the config screen: Cloth Config 11.1+ and Mod Menu 7.2+

Still a beta. Bug reports welcome: include your mod list and `latest.log`.

First public beta of **Diorite Isn't Useless** for Fabric 1.20.1. Diorite finally has a use.

## ⚠ Psychological horror

This mod contains psychological horror elements (the "Abuse Mode"). There are no jumpscares and no flashing lights, and nothing in it will harm your computer, your files or your worlds. A warning screen is shown the first time you start the game. If you only want the tools, the Abuse Mode can be turned off in the config.

## Features

- **Stronger diorite**: higher hardness and blast resistance (configurable).
- **Diorite Crystals**: smelt or blast diorite to get 6 crystals.
- **Dioritine Ingots**: 6 crystals in a 3x2 grid.
- **Dioritine Axe**: fells whole trees in one swing. Sneak to cut a single log.
- **Dioritine Pickaxe**: mines stone and ores in a 3x3 area. Sneak to mine a single block.
- Both tools are great at their job and useless at everything else, and only accept Efficiency and Mending.
- Two advancements to earn.
- Config file (`config/dioriteisntuseless.json`, reload with `/diu reload`) and an in-game config screen with Cloth Config and Mod Menu.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer
- Fabric API
- Fabric Language Kotlin 1.14.1+kotlin.2.4.20 or newer
- Optional, for the config screen: Cloth Config 11.1+ and Mod Menu 7.2+

## Beta

This is a beta, so expect rough edges. If you find a bug, please report it with your game version, your mod list and the log.
